rows.behavior_contract: A participant/dialog replacement or collection-scope rebuild must not leave stale duplicate Search results; the current replacement row controls the one canonical participant projection.
rows.state_machine: authoritative roster -> optional stale/replacement coexistence -> canonical-id collapse -> tab/query projection -> activation; scope/filter rebuild recomputes the projection from current authoritative rows.
side_effects: Updates Universal Search result projection only
Preserves existing result position while replacing stale row data
failure_cases: Duplicate participant result after row replacement
Search tab/filter projection deduped against an older collection generation
rows.ui_disposition: Reuse the existing Fabushi Universal Search Command Palette; do not port Telegram ShareBox presentation.
non_ui_responsibilities: Provider stale-response fencing remains owned by existing Command Palette provider lifecycle
rows.platform_delta: Telegram dialog-row/filter mechanics are re-expressed as a source-neutral canonical participant Search projection in TypeScript.
rows.existing_owner: Fabushi Command Palette canonical Search projection
rejected_existing_owners: group-members-root: object-scoped member surface rather than Universal Search truth
host roster_search: backend/provider responsibility rather than renderer projection identity
rows.language_rationale: This responsibility is a renderer/UI projection over canonical Fabushi state, so it belongs in the existing React/TypeScript Search owner rather than a new Rust or Telegram-specific subsystem.
command_event_contracts: Participant result activation -> existing canonical agent/conversation open action
rows.state_owner: Existing authoritative renderer roster plus Command Palette Search projection
rows.persistence_and_restart: No new persistence. Projection is recomputed from the authoritative roster after reload/restart.
rows.concurrency_and_cancellation: Projection is synchronous; existing Command Palette provider request-id/AbortController fencing remains the owner for asynchronous search freshness.
rows.security_boundary: The projection can only dedupe/project identities already supplied by the authorized canonical roster/provider; it does not broaden result visibility.
network_service_dependencies: Existing canonical Search/provider services only; no new network contract introduced by this responsibility
blockers: Independent row review and artifact-bound verified evidence remain open
production_entrypoints: ProductShell -> ProductionRenderer -> CommandPalette -> commandPaletteEntries -> canonical participant activation
rows.duplicate_root_check: No new Search, Participant, Conversation, route, or visual root was introduced.
rows.creation_flow: Not applicable; result activation reuses existing canonical navigation.
rows.route_contract: Use existing canonical participant/agent/conversation navigation; no source-specific route.
rows.search_provider: Existing Fabushi Command Palette providers and canonical roster projection
rows.search_permission_contract: Authorization/filtering stays upstream in the canonical roster/provider; projection does not add unauthorized identities.
rows.search_local_remote_contract: Local canonical roster projection and existing remote/provider results share one Command Palette result composition; replacement dedupe happens before tab/query projection.
rows.responsive_disposition: No responsive contract change; reuse existing Command Palette behavior.
rows.accessibility_contract: No a11y root/component change; existing Command Palette result semantics remain authoritative.
rows.keyboard_contract: Existing Command Palette keyboard selection/tab/activation contract unchanged.
rows.state_continuity_contract: Replacement dedupe is recomputed from current roster on each projection and survives reload by derivation rather than a parallel cache.
ui_acceptance_scenarios: A stale and replacement row with one stable id render one result
A hidden stale row replaced by visible current row renders one visible result
rows.design_system_version: FBCP Revision 7 live Fabushi design system
semantic_token_usage: Existing Command Palette semantic styling only
rows.motion_contract: Existing Command Palette motion behavior unchanged.
rows.license_and_provenance: Behavior was reimplemented source-neutrally from the accepted telegramdesktop/tdesktop authority; no Telegram UI/product root or retained C++ runtime was introduced.
rows.notes: This row covers only the row-replacement/filter-rebuild Search responsibility. It intentionally does not decrement global unknown/unread for the rest of share_box.cpp or mark the responsibility verified.
